title: 拾听原创 · 日常英语

source.title: 拾听原创示例，非六级真题

articles.title: A small change, a better morning

transcript.en: For years, Emma began every morning by checking her phone.
transcript.zh: 多年来，艾玛每天早晨的第一件事就是看手机。

transcript.en: Before she even got out of bed, she was already thinking about work.
transcript.zh: 她还没起床，就已经在想着工作了。

transcript.en: One Monday, she decided to leave her phone in the kitchen overnight.
transcript.zh: 一个星期一，她决定把手机留在厨房里过夜。

transcript.en: The next morning, she opened the window and made herself a cup of tea.
transcript.zh: 第二天早晨，她打开窗户，给自己泡了一杯茶。

transcript.en: It was a small change, but it gave her ten quiet minutes to start the day.
transcript.zh: 这是个小改变，却让她有了十分钟的安静时光来开启一天。

transcript.en: Now, she says that a better morning does not have to be a busy one.
transcript.zh: 现在，她说，更好的早晨不一定要忙碌。

questions.prompt: What did Emma use to do first in the morning?
questions.explanation: 开头提到：Emma began every morning by checking her phone。注意 used to 表示过去的习惯。

questions.prompt: Where did she leave her phone overnight?
questions.explanation: 她决定 leave her phone in the kitchen overnight，把手机放在厨房里过夜。

questions.prompt: What did this small change give Emma?
questions.explanation: 文章直接说 it gave her ten quiet minutes to start the day，强调更平静地开始一天。

articles.title: The little library on the corner

transcript.en: Last spring, our neighborhood opened a small library in an empty shop.
transcript.zh: 去年春天，我们社区在一家空置的商店里开了一个小图书馆。

transcript.en: It has no staff, and visitors can borrow books without a library card.
transcript.zh: 这里没有工作人员，访客不用借书证就可以借书。

transcript.en: The only rule is to bring a book back, or leave a different one for someone else.
transcript.zh: 唯一的规则是还一本书，或者留下另一本给其他人。

transcript.en: At first, people worried that the shelves would soon be empty.
transcript.zh: 最初，人们担心书架很快就会空了。

transcript.en: Instead, the library now has more books than it did on its first day.
transcript.zh: 结果恰恰相反，图书馆现在的书比开馆第一天还多。

transcript.en: Sometimes, a little trust is all a community needs.
transcript.zh: 有时候，一个社区所需要的只是一点信任。

options.text: It has no staff or library cards.

questions.explanation: 第二句说明 no staff 和 without a library card，是图书馆的特别之处。

questions.prompt: What happened to the number of books?
questions.explanation: more books than it did on its first day 表明书的数量增加了。
